import html # Predefined HTML template for a blog post. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog(heading: str, description: str) -> str: """ Prepare a blog post for safe web display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. description : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and HTML‑formatted blog post, ready for secure presentation on a webpage. """ # Escape any special HTML characters to prevent injection attacks safe_title = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(description, quote=True) # Inject the escaped values into the template return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
